gripOrHq.title: Bodyweight™ Data Crèche
gripOrHq.rulesText: Provides +1 MU. Once per turn, right after making a successful run, you can choose to make another run without taking an action to do so. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

gripOrHq.title: The Short Circuit
gripOrHq.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Top Runners' Conference
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

heapOrArchives.title: Forged Activation Orders
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp either rezzes that piece of ice or trashes it.

heapOrArchives.title: Inside Job
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

heapOrArchives.title: Top Runners' Conference
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

heapOrArchives.title: Short-Term Contract
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

heapOrArchives.title: Zetatech Software Installer
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [2] bits on Software Installer when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for installing programs. You may use these bits to install a program overwriting Software Installer itself. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

heapOrArchives.title: R&D Interface
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Coup
scoreArea.rulesText:
Put [15] from the bank on Corporate Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Corporate Coup, if it has any bits.

rig.title: Zetatech Software Installer
rig.rulesText: Put [2] bits on Software Installer when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for installing programs. You may use these bits to install a program overwriting Software Installer itself. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rig.title: Rigged Investments
rig.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Rigged Investments when it is installed. At the start of each of your turns, take [1] from Rigged Investments. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rigged Investments.

rig.title: Silicon Saloon Franchise
rig.rulesText: A: Gain [1] and draw one card.

rig.title: Top Runners' Conference
rig.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

ice.title: Fatal Attractor
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] The next time Runner encounters a piece of ice during the run, do 3 Net damage unless Runner breaks all subroutines of that piece of ice.

root.title: Hacker Tracker Central
root.rulesText: After each trace attempt, whether successful or not, put 1 from the bank on Hacker Tracker Central. During a trace attempt, each bit you spend from Hacker Tracker Central increases by 1 both your trace value and your trace limit.

ice.title: Fang
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 4 - If trace is successful, end the run, and Runner cannot run again until Runner takes an action to pay [2].

ice.title: Rex
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 3 - If trace is successful, end the run, and Runner cannot run again until Runner takes an action to pay [2].
